info.description: This course consists of 6 chapters, and each highlights in-depth contents of Meaning and Semantics, Dimensions of Meaning, Ambiguity, Meaning and Context, Meaning and Logic and Meaning Relation
info.decisionNo: Ban hành theo QĐ CTĐT TDTU

clos.loDetails: Understand and distinguish basic semantic issues such as meaning, reference, word meaning, sentence meaning, compositional meaning, utterance meaning, denotation, connotation, ambiguity, deixis, presupposition, meaning and logic, sense relations, etc.; identify the terms and concepts systematically.
Apply what they have learnt in semantics in order to do major-related research as well as to learn other languages

Have good behaviour in acquiring and applying semantic knowledge in particular and linguistic knowledge in general in order to communicate effectively; be aware of the social and humane values of this course; have appropriate attitude toward their own career and society; apprehend the connection between this course and others in linguistics
